process_area.title: Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics

value_stream.name: Field Sales, Outside Sales & Route-to-Market Force Management

fields.Owner: Sales Operations / Head of Field Sales

workflows.name: Field Sales Performance & Quota Attainment Management

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time attainment dashboards; performance-alert automation; PIP tracking
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: attainment rules clean & audited; underperformance managed (PIP)
Cross-references: - links to W4221 (quota), W4228 (pipeline), VS-102 (comp), VS-17.4 (finance), VS-28 (analytics), W4238 (coaching)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Gaming risk**: Reps manipulate timing/credits to hit quota; mitigated by clean-attainment rules + audit
- **Late-intervention risk**: Underperformance addressed too late; mitigated by monthly review + PIP
System Touchpoints: - CRM attainment (VS-11); analytics (VS-28); finance (VS-17.4); comp (VS-102); quota (W4221)

steps.activity: Sales Ops measure rep/territory/team attainment vs quota (W4221), and pipeline coverage vs target, with margin/revenue/mix views
Regional Mgr review attainment with reps, identify high/low performers, and intervene (coaching W4238, reallocation, PIP)
Sales Ops report attainment/performance to leadership, feed comp (W4234) and workforce planning (W4239), and adjust forecasts (W4228)

fields.Participants: Comp (VS-102.3), Payroll (VS-19.2), Finance (VS-17.4), Sales Ops, HR (VS-19)

Automation Opportunity: - Comp-calc automation from CRM attainment; rep self-service statements; plan-modeling tools
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: comp validated & transparent; plan margin-aware & reviewed annually (VS-102)
Cross-references: - links to VS-102.3 (variable pay), VS-19.2 (payroll), VS-11 (attainment), VS-17.4 (finance), W4221 (quota), W4233 (performance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Comp-error risk**: Wrong commission → disputes/overpay; mitigated by validation + transparency
- **Mis-incent risk**: Plan drives volume over margin/wrong behavior; mitigated by margin-aware design + annual review
System Touchpoints: - Comp plan (VS-102.3); payroll (VS-19.2); CRM attainment (VS-11); finance (VS-17.4); HR (VS-19)
Time Estimate: - Per cycle ~2–4 days; annual plan review weeks

steps.activity: Comp/Sales Ops compute commission/incentive from attainment (W4233) per the plan (W4221/VS-102.3), with splits/credits, caps, and margin adjustments
Comp/Payroll validate, route approvals, and pay via payroll (VS-19.2), with transparency (rep statement) and dispute handling

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CHRO / CFO
steps.activity: Comp/Finance/HR review plan effectiveness (does it drive right behavior/ROI?), adjust annually (W4221), and govern plan change (VS-102)
steps.r: Comp / Finance / HR / Head of Field Sales

fields.Participants: Analytics (VS-28), Regional Mgrs, Insights (VS-44), Merchandising (VS-01), Pricing (VS-57)

Automation Opportunity: - Pipeline-conversion analytics; win/loss-reason capture; AI insight (governed VS-128)
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: win/loss reasons captured & analyzed; metrics outcome-focused
Cross-references: - links to VS-11 (CRM), VS-28 (BI), VS-44 (insights), VS-33.3 (competitive intel), VS-57 (pricing), VS-128 (AI), W4233 (performance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Blind-loss risk**: Losses not analyzed → repeat; mitigated by structured win/loss analysis
- **Vanity-metric risk**: Tracking activity not outcomes; mitigated by conversion/ROI metrics
System Touchpoints: - CRM analytics (VS-11); BI (VS-28); insights (VS-44); competitive intel (VS-33.3); pricing (VS-57)

steps.activity: Sales Ops/Analytics measure pipeline metrics — conversion rate by stage, win-rate, sales-cycle length, average deal size, slip/loss reasons
Sales Ops/Insights analyze win/loss drivers (price, availability, spec, competitor, relationship — links to VS-33.3 competitive intel, VS-44 insights) and share with merchandising/pricing
Sales Ops act on insights (pricing/availability/spec/enablement changes), track improvement, and report to leadership (W4233)

fields.Participants: Regional Mgrs, Analytics (VS-28), Trade Sales (VS-11), Logistics route (VS-06)

workflows.name: Route Efficiency, Coverage Adherence & Field Productivity

Controls: - CTL-652: coverage adherence monitored; selling-time optimized (admin-reduction VS-133)
Cross-references: - links to VS-11/W4224 (CRM/route), VS-28 (analytics), VS-06 (route optimization), VS-133 (OpEx/admin-reduction), W4219 (territory), W4220 (coverage)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Low-selling-time risk**: Reps bogged in admin; mitigated by admin-reduction/tooling (VS-133/W4224)
- **Coverage-skew risk**: Actual ≠ plan; mitigated by adherence monitoring + coaching
System Touchpoints: - Mobile CRM/route data (VS-11/W4224); analytics (VS-28); logistics route (VS-06); OpEx (VS-133)

steps.activity: Sales Ops/Analytics measure route efficiency (visits/day, travel time/cost, territory balance) and coverage adherence (actual vs planned call-frequency W4220)
Sales Ops/Regional Mgr measure field productivity (selling time vs admin, activity-to-outcome) and identify coaching/route/tooling improvements
Sales Ops optimize routes/coverage (re-territory W4219, tooling W4224, admin-reduction links to VS-133), and report productivity gains (W4233)

fields.Owner: Sales Operations / Key Accounts (VS-107) / Trade Sales (VS-11)
fields.Participants: Trade Sales (VS-11), Key Accounts (VS-107), Trade-Pro (VS-43), CDP (VS-126), CX (VS-13)
fields.Trigger: Churn signal; account-health review; retention cycle

Automation Opportunity: - Account-health scoring (VS-126); churn-risk AI early-warning (governed VS-128); save-action tracking
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: account-health monitored; at-risk accounts intervened; churn root-caused
Cross-references: - links to VS-126 (CDP/account-health), VS-11 (CRM), VS-13 (CX/NPS), VS-43 (trade-pro), VS-44 (insights), VS-128 (AI), W4233 (performance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Silent-churn risk**: Accounts churn without signal; mitigated by account-health scoring + early intervention
- **Low-retention-ROI risk**: Save-actions not measured; mitigated by retention analytics

steps.activity: Sales Ops/CDP compute account-health (spend trend, recency, share-of-wallet, NPS, engagement — links to VS-126) and flag at-risk/churn accounts
Trade Sales/Key Accounts intervene on at-risk accounts (win-back, relationship, issue resolution — links to VS-13 CX, VS-43 trade-pro), and document save actions
Sales Ops measure retention/churn rate, root-cause churn (price/service/competition — links to VS-44), and report to leadership (W4233)

fields.Owner: Regional Managers / Head of Field Sales / Enablement (VS-124)
fields.Participants: Regional Mgrs, Enablement (VS-124), HR (VS-19.1), Sales Ops

workflows.name: Field Sales Coaching, Performance Management & Recognition

Automation Opportunity: - Coaching-cadence tracking; performance-development plans; recognition automation
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: coaching cadence enforced; PIP for underperformers; recognition fair/consistent
Cross-references: - links to VS-124 (enablement), VS-19.1 (performance mgmt), VS-102 (comp/recognition), W4233 (performance data)
Pain Points / Risks: - **No-coaching risk**: Reps underdeveloped → low performance/retention; mitigated by coaching cadence
- **Inconsistent-mgmt risk**: Manager quality varies; mitigated by manager enablement/standards
System Touchpoints: - Performance data (W4233); enablement (VS-124); HR/performance mgmt (VS-19.1); comp/recognition (VS-102)

steps.activity: Regional Mgr conduct regular coaching (ride-alongs, call coaching, pipeline review) using performance data (W4233), and develop reps
Regional Mgr/HR manage performance (goals, feedback, PIP for underperformers, development for high-potential — links to VS-19.1 performance mgmt)
Head of Field Sales/Enablement recognize/reward top performers (spiffs, awards, career path — links to VS-102, VS-124), and reinforce desired behaviors

fields.Owner: Head of Field Sales / Finance (VS-17.4) / Workforce Planning (VS-103.3)
fields.Trigger: Annual planning; cost review; growth decision
fields.Volume: Force cost (comp, travel, tooling) vs B2B revenue contribution

workflows.name: Field Sales Force Cost, ROI & Workforce Planning

Automation Opportunity: - Force-cost/ROI dashboards; cost-to-serve analytics; workforce-planning models
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: force ROI monitored; cost/coverage trade-off optimized; workforce planned vs growth (VS-33)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (finance), VS-103.3 (workforce planning), VS-102 (comp cost), VS-121 (recruitment), W4218 (sizing), W4222 (channel), W4236 (productivity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cost-inefficiency risk**: Force cost outruns revenue contribution; mitigated by ROI monitoring + channel shift
- **Under-investment risk**: Cutting force loses B2B revenue/share; mitigated by ROI-justified sizing
System Touchpoints: - Finance (VS-17.4); workforce planning (VS-103.3); comp cost (VS-102); analytics (VS-28); channel (W4222)
Time Estimate: - Annual planning weeks; quarterly ROI ~finance capacity

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CFO
steps.activity: Finance/Sales Ops measure force cost-to-serve and ROI (B2B revenue attributable vs comp/travel/tooling cost), and cost-per-account/cost-per-order

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CHRO
steps.activity: Field Sales/Workforce Planning plan the workforce (sizing W4218, structure, hiring plan links to VS-121/VS-103.3) against the B2B-growth plan (VS-33)
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / Workforce Planning

steps.a: Head of Trade / Account Management / CFO
steps.activity: Field Sales/Finance optimize the cost/coverage trade-off (force vs digital/store channel shift W4222, productivity W4236), and report force ROI to leadership

fields.Owner: Head of Field Sales / OpEx (VS-133) / Enablement (VS-124)
fields.Participants: OpEx (VS-133), Enablement (VS-124), Sales Ops, Analytics (VS-28), HR (VS-19)
fields.Trigger: OpEx cycle; capability review; market/strategy change

workflows.name: Field Sales Continuous Improvement & Capability Building

Automation Opportunity: - Process-mining on sales activity; capability-gap analytics; standard-work automation
Controls: - CTL-652 (ensure controlled execution — Field Sales Performance, Compensation & Route Analytics (PA-140.3).)
- CTL-652: improvements benefit-tracked (VS-133); changes sustained via standard work/training
Cross-references: - links to VS-133 (OpEx), VS-124 (enablement), VS-112 (PMO), VS-28 (analytics), VS-128 (AI/data-driven), W4217 (strategy), W4235/W4236 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stasis risk**: Force doesn't evolve with market/digital; mitigated by capability-building & OpEx
- **No-sustainment risk**: Improvements fade; mitigated by standard work + training
System Touchpoints: - OpEx/process mining (VS-133); enablement (VS-124); PMO (VS-112); analytics (VS-28); AI/data-driven (VS-128)

steps.activity: Head of Field Sales/OpEx identify improvement opportunities (process friction, admin load, tooling gaps, skill gaps) from analytics (W4235/W4236) and rep feedback
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / OpEx / Sales Ops

steps.activity: Field Sales/Enablement build capabilities (new selling motions, digital/spec selling, data-driven selling — links to VS-124/VS-128) and run improvement projects (VS-133/VS-112)
steps.r: Head of Field Sales / Enablement / OpEx

steps.activity: Field Sales measure improvement impact (productivity, conversion, ROI), sustain changes (standard work, training), and feed learnings into strategy (W4217)
